description: Evaluation préliminaire des risques d’inondation (EPRI) de Corse is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Corse. Corsica’s EPRI is based on information that is available or can be easily deduced, such as historical surveys and studies on long-term developments, including climate change and its impact on flood management. Coverage: DREAL Corse. The portal shows the English title as "Preliminary Flood Risk Assessment (EPRI) of Corsica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Corse. Its keywords include observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement, hvd. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
